preconditions.description: The host is already approved in config/sources.json, or the change is quarantined and cannot be promoted in the same change.
The real provider output has been captured, or the fixture is a synthetic input and is labelled as one per tests/fixtures/README.md.

subtasks.name: parse one provider unit into the existing shape, refusing rather than guessing
pin the source with the date and the evidence it was verified against
declare the format or relation in the registry, never sniff it from the body
prove the guard fails when the fix is reverted
the product graders and the contract agree on what changed

preconditions.description: The failure is classified before anything is attempted: blocked, gone, server fault or unreachable. A block is not a markup change.
The diagnosis is read from the response, not guessed from the status code; a challenge is not a throttle.

subtasks.name: record the failing fetch with the evidence that identifies the block
prefer a durable format over a render, and say why in the reference
the recall denominator is widened, or the remaining gap is written down

preconditions.description: The behaviour under test is a claim about the system, not a description of the current code.

subtasks.name: reintroduce the defect and confirm the guard goes red
assert the guard reads its real source, not a constant that mirrors it
